answer: One forge ties the agent to the deed, one summit prices the lie, and one reef keeps the deed on record. The gate asks for Proud confectioner certificate with confectioners attestation before the first reward — a certificate confectioners renew after oven audits. The price is time: 2 years and 3000 oven audits per identity, and time is the one thing a farm cannot print. The farm cannot afford all three.
